observations: Photo 0 shows a blue plastic cylindrical drum with a sealed-looking lid secured by metal latches/straps.
Photo 0 shows a small round cap/port on the top surface of the drum.
Photo 1 shows the same blue drum from a slightly different angle; lid latches and top cap/port are visible.
No readable brand/model name is visible on the drum or lid in either photo.
The drum appears scuffed/used; no visible liquid inside; no labels or contents are readable.

claims.evidence: No quality standard, testing, or condition details are shown beyond general appearance in photo 0 and photo 1.

risks.risk: Unknown drum capacity/size (price depends heavily on liters/volume). Photos don’t show any capacity marking.
risks.proof: A clear photo of any printed capacity/volume marking (e.g., 25L/50L/100L/200L) on the drum body or lid, or a tape-measure shot showing height and diameter.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used plastic chemical drum of unknown capacity (worst-case: smaller/less valuable size).

risks.risk: Unknown contents history / contamination risk (could be previously used for chemicals/food/non-food). Photos show no label or residue check.
risks.proof: A photo of the drum’s label/previous contents (if any) and an inside view (open lid) showing cleanliness/residue; also ask what it was last used for.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed clean/food-safe (worst-case: treated as potentially contaminated).

risks.risk: Lid seal and leak risk (latches are visible but gasket/condition and tightness are not).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lid seal/gasket area and a simple leak test video (fill with water and show no seepage).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as may leak / not confirmed watertight (worst-case: assume needs resealing).

risks.risk: Damage/weak spots (scuffs are visible; cracks or dents can’t be confirmed from these angles).
risks.proof: Photos of the entire drum including bottom, side seams, and any dents/cracks; plus a close-up of the top cap/port area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with possible wear (worst-case: assume minor damage affecting value).

proof_requests: Clear photo of any capacity/volume marking on the drum (and/or height/diameter measurement).
Photo of the label/previous contents (or confirmation of what it was used for).
Open-lid photo showing inside cleanliness and the condition of the gasket/seal.
Leak test proof (water fill + short video showing no leakage).
Photos of the bottom and all sides for cracks/dents, especially around the top cap/port.
response.reason: From the photos, it’s a used blue plastic lidded chemical storage drum, but key pricing drivers (capacity, cleanliness/contents history, and whether it’s watertight) are not verifiable remotely. Request the capacity marking and leak/inside condition proof before pricing.
